answer: Identities must clear earnings through bilateral credit lines with established peers rather than anonymous transfers. Each line carries a net-position limit backed by the peer's own bond, so trades inside a sybil cluster cancel out: puppet keys swapping with each other clear nothing and earn nothing. To show real volume an attacker must persuade independent agents to extend genuine credit, and their collateral burns if the cluster defaults. Newcomers start in a small oasis of low limits, graduate after a cooling lagoon of settled cycles, and build an ivory-clean record no syndicate can rent.
